import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Disable progress bars
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
np.seterr(divide="ignore")

print("Loading dataset...")

# Load data from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features and target from train set
X_train_full = train_df.drop(columns=["Id"])
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].values

# Split training data into train and validation sets (50% validation for robustness)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full.reset_index(drop=True), y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42
)

# Scale features - ONLY fit on training data
scaler = StandardScaler()

X_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr.reset_index(drop=True))
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val.reset_index(drop=True))

# Get test data without "Id" column for feature extraction
X_test_clean = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_clean.reset_index(drop=True))

# Train Random Forest model on scaled training data only
clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
clf.fit(X_tr_scaled, y_tr)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set (model never sees this during training)
y_val_pred = clf.predict(X_val_scaled)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
y_test_pred = clf.predict(X_test_scaled)

# Create submission file using sample_submission as template
# This ensures correct column names and order
submission_template = sample_submission.copy()

# Overwrite with correct values
submission_df = submission_template.copy()
submission_df["Id"] = test_df["Id"].values.astype(str)
submission_df["Cover_Type"] = y_test_pred.values

# Save to required directory path
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to submission/submission.csv")
